description: Ad-hoc metrics pull dispatched at the canonical qualified id with html format; analytics-agent reads the read-only API key, pulls the requested metrics over web_fetch, publishes the HTML report through preview-host (publish_preview), and completes with the signed preview URL + digest.

inputs.metrics: DAU last 7d, top 5 events, active users

dispatch.title: Ad-hoc report: DAU last 7d, top 5 events, active users

args.note: HogQL: top 5 events by volume, last 7d

args.result: Ad-hoc report published: https://preview.pancake.dev/r/adhoc-2026-06-12 (signed URL on the ticket). DAU 7d avg 405; top events slack_relayed, task_created, digest_opened, login, report_generated; 1,930 distinct active users in the window.
args.digest: Ad-hoc pull, html format requested so published via preview-host instead of the wiki. All three metrics from eu.posthog.com with the read-only key. Numbers consistent with yesterday's daily digest — no anomaly flags.
